title: Line Reactor, EMC Filter & Harmonic Mitigation for VFD Drives — Pakistan 2026 Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete Pakistan 2026 buyer guide to line reactors, EMC/RFI filters, DC link chokes, active harmonic filters and common-mode chokes for VFD drives. Covers Pakistan Grid Code THDi limits for all 11 DISCOs, KE AMI automated enforcement (Jan 2025), weak-grid ACL sizing for PESCO/TESCO/QESCO, PKR price table, SRD import duties (HS codes), VFD motor bearing damage mitigation, and 7 Pakistan-exclusive data points.
